summary: Regression test for redesigned 3D topographic terrain view in Pulse map. Verified terrain rendering, count label, rotation, click-to-investigate, 2D regression, view toggle URL sync, heat-toggle disable state in 3D, and Get Notified modal. All 8 requested checks pass.

issues: Tooltip on disabled heat-toggle in 3D still reads 'Heat field is 2D only — hex columns carry the signal in 3D'. Copy is stale post-redesign; should reference the terrain, not hex columns. Non-blocking.

test_results.3d_terrain_renders: PASS — continuous triangle-mesh heightfield paints within ~9s. Screenshot shows peaks, ridges, and valleys with the heat gradient (deep violet lowlands through pink to bright yellow on the tallest peak). No sparse hex columns, not all-white, not monochrome.
test_results.3d_count_label: PASS — top-right pill reads '172 populated cells / 2500 lattice'.
test_results.3d_rotation: PASS — mouse-drag orbits the camera around the terrain. Two screenshots (initial + post-drag) show different orbit angles.
test_results.3d_click_to_investigate: PASS — clicking terrain (empty region) opens region-panel with header 'region 3.42, 8.50 · r=1' and 'nothing here' body copy, matching the spec's empty-region branch.
test_results.2d_regression: PASS — switching to 2D restores heatmap blooms; signals panel populated (YouTube Gaming Clickbait Compilations, US-Canada Trade War Escalation, Minecraft Challenge Videos as top 3, each with in-view counts). Pill reads '267 signals / 6,008 in scope'.
test_results.toggle_url_sync: PASS — view-3d sets ?view=3d in URL; view-2d clears the param (returns to default). Window persistence across toggle: only 24h is available on free tier (72h/7d/30d locked), so multi-window persistence could not be exercised, but URL construction preserves other params (share-link URL retains view/window).
test_results.heat_toggle_disabled_in_3d: PASS — heat-toggle button is_disabled()==true in 3D, greyed with cursor-not-allowed. In 2D is_disabled()==false and label reads 'HEAT FIELD ON'.
test_results.get_notified_modal_from_3d: PASS — clicking get-notified in 3D opens signup-modal (testids signup-modal, signup-email, signup-submit, signup-close all present). Copy: 'Sign-up is on the way.' with email input and Notify Me CTA.

action_items: (Minor copy) Update the disabled heat-toggle tooltip in MapPage.jsx (line ~500) from '...hex columns carry the signal in 3D' to reference the terrain/heightfield, since the old hex-column design is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: terrainMesh.js is well-scoped: log1p compression on counts + two-pass 3x3 box blur produce smooth ridges; low-density vertices lerp to background so empty flatlands sink into the void. Colours are normalised 0..1 floats — correct for deck.gl 9.x SimpleMeshLayer.
MapCanvas.jsx cleanly reuses onClick for both views via info.coordinate. OrbitView with orbitAxis='Z' and drag-rotate controller works as expected.

MapPage.jsx correctly conditions aggregated='grid', resolution=50, points=false when is3D, and correctly disables heat-toggle when is3D. Only cosmetic: the disabled-state tooltip still names 'hex columns'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 requested checks pass; 1 minor stale-copy note)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 3D terrain redesign is verified end-to-end at free tier on desktop 1920x1080 against the live staging tunnel. Only observation is a stale tooltip copy on the disabled heat-toggle referring to 'hex columns' which no longer exist. All data-testids preserved (map-canvas, view-2d, view-3d, region-panel, region-panel-close, region-topics, region-coherence — the latter two only render for populated regions; empty regions correctly render 'nothing here'). Free-tier windows other than 24h are locked, so cross-window persistence across the 2D/3D toggle was not exercised.
